summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the travel/housing transaction-infrastructure node. The cleanest US-listed exposures found in this pass are vertical workflow platforms rather than consumer-facing brands: AppFolio for residential property-management systems, Agilysys for hospitality property-management/POS/workflow software, Blend Labs for mortgage and consumer-banking transaction workflows, and Frontdoor for home repair/warranty contractor-network infrastructure. Sabre and ICE are relevant reference anchors but were not included in the four-candidate list to keep this pass focused on smaller/mid-cap or more node-pure names. MeridianLink was identified as relevant historically but excluded because search evidence indicates it was taken private and delisted in October 2025. Expanded one supply-chain node around scarce operational infrastructure for travel and housing transactions. The strongest fit in this pass is not consumer-facing brands, but vertical software and workflow networks that sit inside fragmented hotel, rental-property, mortgage, and home-services operations. The two-lane list uses AppFolio as a reference-quality public comp for property-management workflow software, then adds smaller or less obvious discovery candidates: Agilysys in hospitality PMS/POS/payments, Blend in mortgage and banking workflow automation, and EverCommerce in home-services field workflow and payments.
